title: feat(objectql): the engine floor over a plugin driver reads the datasource's external.rowCap
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ83WAcW3kdc2RHYZ2aeB5krB)_
Fixes #29762

Clause-②: yes (widening) — the engine floor honours the per-datasource cap from PR 1 (#29762 spec slice)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: updated here — content/docs/data-modeling/virtual-objects.mdx (whole-set views, both ceilings) and odata-datasources.mdx

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:插件驱动数据源的引擎地板改读 `external.rowCap`(上一个 PR #29854 已落 spec 键),每次读取都按当前定义取上限;指南新增「行数上限」与「整集视图」两节。
- 为什么改:客户的虚拟对象甘特图约 5,000 行,固定 1,000 行上限直接 422;Warren 裁定 (a)+(c),平台最大值 10,000。
- 风险与回滚:不写该键的数据源仍是 1,000,行为不变;引擎读到无法照写兑现的值(超 10,000 或非整数)时按上限/默认取值并在服务端日志警告一次;写了的数据源每页从远端读最多两倍上限行数。回滚即 revert 本 PR(spec 键留着,只是不生效)。
- 先看:`packages/objectql/src/external-driver-floor.ts`(`readCapped` 取 cap)→ `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`(`applyExternalDriverFloor` 的 `rowCap` 回调)→ `content/docs/data-modeling/virtual-objects.mdx`(两节新文档)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/external-driver-floor.test.ts -t 29762`,预期 7 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **The floor reads the cap on every read.** `readCapped` calls `resolveExternalRowCap(host.rowCap?.())`, sends `limit: cap + 1`, and refuses past `cap` with `new ExternalRowCapExceededError(datasource, object, cap)`. The engine's host callback reads `this.datasourceDefs.get(name)?.external?.rowCap` at the time of the read, because a redefinition that keeps the floor returns early in `applyExternalDriverFloor` and never re-wraps the driver.
- **`resolveExternalRowCap`** (`external-driver-errors.ts`, not exported from the package): a whole number from 1 to `EXTERNAL_ROW_CAP_CEILING` is the cap; above the ceiling is held at the ceiling; anything else (absent, 0, negative, fractional, a string) is the default. The schema already refuses all of those at the authoring door; this is the engine's reading of a def that reached it unparsed. When a written value is not honoured as written, the floor says so in the server log (`logger.warn`, meta `{ datasource, rowCapWritten, rowCapUsed }`), once per value written to that datasource (contract-review should-fix 2 on 3f1cd437).
- **`EXTERNAL_ROW_CAP`** now reads `EXTERNAL_ROW_CAP_DEFAULT` from `@objectstack/spec/data` (same value, 1000), and its docblock says it is the default since #29762 rather than "not an authorable key".
- **The refusal names the cap.** `details.cap` and the message carry the datasource's cap; below the ceiling the message adds that an administrator may raise `external.rowCap` (at most 10,000).
- **Contracts.** `EngineDatasourceDef.external` (`@objectstack/spec/contracts`) and objectql's `DatasourceDef.external` declare `rowCap?: number`, the key the engine now reads.
- **Liveness.** `external.rowCap` flips from `planned` to `live`, citing `external-driver-floor.ts#createExternalDriverFloor` and `engine.ts#applyExternalDriverFloor` (with the connection service as `producer`). The `external` parent's stale "5 of 7 live" note is rewritten: 7 of 7, with the #4583 history of the two removed keys.
- **Docs.** `virtual-objects.mdx`: new sections "The row cap" (default, ceiling, how to set it, what a higher cap costs the remote, what to do past it) and "Views that read the whole set" (gantt, tree, calendar, map: the server's row cap and the views' own 2,000-row ceiling in one table, what each band of set size gets, and two habits for planners). Every `1000` / `1001` the page pinned is restated against the cap, including the driver-author rule "never hard-code 1001". `odata-datasources.mdx` says the cap is the datasource's and that the OData driver follows a raised cap unchanged.

## Tests

- `packages/objectql/src/external-driver-floor.test.ts`, describe `[#29762] the datasource's external.rowCap`: a 2,500 cap is the limit sent (2501) and enforced on count and a deep page; one row past it is refused 422 with `details.cap` and the key in the message; a cap below the default is honoured; a redefinition applies to the next read without re-wrapping the driver (same held instance); `resolveExternalRowCap` over undefined, in-range, the ceiling, ceiling + 1, and 0 / -5 / 1.5 / NaN / '5000' / null; one warn for `50_000` (cap used 10,000) and one for `'5000'` (cap used 1,000) across three reads each, none for `5000` or an absent key; at the ceiling the message offers no higher cap.
- `packages/spec/src/data/datasource.test.ts`: the alias test now covers `maxRowCount` beside `maxRows` and `rowLimit` (contract-review note on #29854).

## Acceptance notes

- Measurement: issue comment 6595439927. Ruling: (a) + (c), ceiling 10,000. Spec slice: #29854 (merged). Contract review on #29854 (6598079463) listed six items for this PR; all six are here. Contract review on this PR (6600064400) PASS at 3f1cd437 with two should-fixes, both in 0fc5c2d3: `Metadata-protocol: none` (PR 1 added the authorable key; this diff changes nothing an author can write), both packages `patch`; and the once-per-value warn above.
- **The 2,000-row view ceiling is unchanged.** `NON_GRID_ROW_CEILING` (`ui/packages/core/src/utils/non-grid-row-ceiling.ts`, objectui#7210 ruling a′) was not ruled on. With a cap of 5,000, the customer's 5,000-row gantt draws its first 2,000 rows with the ceiling note instead of failing with 422; drawing all of them needs its own ruling. The guide says so.
- **No conformance-kit case.** The kit still sends `EXTERNAL_ROW_CAP + 1`. A driver that hard-codes 1001 would pass any small-fixture case and come up short under a raised cap, so no case the kit can run detects it; the guide tells driver authors to honour the limit they are sent instead. `driver-odata` already does (`odata-driver.ts`, `$top` from `query.limit`).
- The runtime spike test (`plugin-driver-external-object.spike.test.ts`) pins `limit: EXTERNAL_ROW_CAP + 1` for a datasource with no key; it stays valid as the default and is unchanged.

## Verification

Head `0ca2cf49`. Readings below are on `0fc5c2d3` (branch on `origin/main` `2a1be29e` after #29854 merged; the review should-fixes are the one commit on top of `3f1cd437`), except where named. `0ca2cf49` changes only the `external.rowCap` liveness row's evidence text (re-quoted against `capInForce`); on it, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:liveness` and `check:generated` both exit 0.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql test`: Test Files 544 passed, Tests 10777 passed (`VERDICT command-exit 0`). `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/external-driver-floor.test.ts` + objectql typecheck: 64 passed, clean.
- On `3f1cd437` (the should-fix commit touches only objectql and the changeset): `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck && pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: Test Files 807 passed, Tests 24054 passed, 1 todo.
- `pnpm lint` (`eslint . --no-inline-config`): exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 108 families (the same 108 as on `3f1cd437`); `--ran` reconciliation: "108 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 107 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (1 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)".

<details><summary>Gate readings</summary>

- Every derived family exit 0 except one NOT MEASURED, exit 3 (prerequisite): `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test`, whose positive control is pinned to a commit outside this shallow clone. It is checker health, not a verdict on this diff, and runs in CI.
- `check:liveness` green with the row flipped to `live`; `liveness/state-counts/datasource.md` regenerated on the new base (`gen:liveness-counts`).
- Not run locally: full dogfood (the title carries no `!` and the Clause-② arm is widening, not narrowing).

</details>
